admission_disposition.reason: Native WNN is a dataset-fitted multimodal neighbor graph, not a pretrained frozen encoder and not an RNA-to-ATAC decoder. Its valid input is observed paired modalities on the same cells or nuclei.

checkpoint_contract.fit_artifact: A project WNN object contains data-derived modality weights, nearest-neighbor indices, and graph geometry and must receive its own immutable training-row, parameter, runtime, and output hashes.
checkpoint_contract.important_distinction: A code revision does not define a biological representation. Every fitted WNN graph is specific to the cells, modalities, reductions, features, and parameters supplied.

native_architecture_contract.replication_rule: Cells or nuclei define graph rows but are not biological replicates; donor remains the inferential unit.

frozen_function_contract.fit_behavior: FindMultiModalNeighbors invokes modality-weight estimation and multimodal neighbor construction on the supplied object. Modality weights and neighborhoods depend on the supplied rows and modality reductions.
frozen_function_contract.transductive_consequence: Running native WNN jointly on training and held-query rows, or rerunning it after adding query rows, changes the learned graph using held-query geometry. That is target-fitted transduction, not a frozen inductive transform.

method_identity_boundaries.native_WNN: Observed paired modalities enter modality-weight and neighbor estimation for each supplied row.
method_identity_boundaries.multimodal_reference_mapping: A separate Seurat workflow can use a WNN reference and supervised PCA plus FindTransferAnchors and MapQuery. It is not native WNN and must be separately registered; query geometry still enters anchor and mapping operations.
method_identity_boundaries.bridge_integration: FindBridgeIntegrationAnchors is a separate bridge workflow requiring a modality-spanning bridge reference. A multiome bridge must contain true same-cell or same-nucleus modalities. It cannot create pairs for separate aliquots.
method_identity_boundaries.RNA_to_ATAC_translation: Not implemented by WNN, reference mapping, or bridge anchors. A separate decoder and TaskSpec would be required.

task_capability.cell_state_mapping: Native WNN is not admitted because project-sealed GSE289173 supplies RNA only and the task requires the same RNA-only query universe for every candidate. A separately registered reference-mapping method may be audited later but cannot inherit the seurat_wnn identity or be called frozen without a query-composition test.
task_capability.rna_conditioned_atac: Ineligible and explicitly latent-only. Native WNN requires observed query ATAC and emits graph geometry rather than a peak profile or count. Supplying held-donor ATAC would violate the TaskSpec.
task_capability.clinical: No diagnosis, prognosis, treatment-response, clinical-decision, or deployment claim.

missingness_contract.rule: A missing modality remains structurally_missing, unavailable_permission, join_unresolved, withheld_sealed, or another registered explicit state. It is never an all-zero assay.
missingness_contract.RNA_only_query: Native WNN is not callable because the query lacks the required observed ATAC reduction.
missingness_contract.separate_aliquots: RNA and ATAC rows retain distinct IDs and cannot be concatenated into fictitious paired cells or nuclei.

safe_loading_contract.external_R_serialization: Do not load untrusted RDS, RData, Seurat, graph, or Annoy-index objects into the benchmark runtime.
safe_loading_contract.project_fit: Construct from admitted matrices and reductions inside the fold, then export bounded plain artifacts such as Matrix Market or Parquet/TSV row-edge tables, modality-weight tables, reduction matrices, JSON metadata, and hashes.
safe_loading_contract.Annoy_index: If used, bind index bytes, row order, feature/reduction identity, RcppAnnoy version, metric, tree/search parameters, and seed; never accept an unmanifested serialized index.

runtime_contract.required_probe: After campaign approval only: CPU-SLURM install or restore from a frozen lock, same-row and row-permutation fixtures, paired-topology rejection, missing-modality rejection, donor-fold isolation, query-composition sensitivity, deterministic-neighbor tolerance, export/reload, memory, and sessionInfo capture.

terms_audit.code: The pinned repository and CRAN metadata declare MIT plus the package LICENSE file.
terms_audit.fitted_objects: Data-derived modality weights, reductions, neighbors, graphs, and indexes are governed by project input-data terms and cannot be assumed redistributable merely because the code is MIT.
terms_audit.derivative_code: MIT conditions apply to modified code; every dependency and any copied vignette or data asset requires a separate terms audit.
terms_audit.outputs: Release only bounded derived outputs whose source-data permissions and privacy review permit redistribution.
terms_audit.open_champion: Code terms alone do not block an open implementation, but the registered method is ineligible because it has no current supported or sealed endpoint.

source_evidence: Official immutable GitHub source, official CRAN metadata, official Seurat WNN and bridge documentation, and the primary Cell paper were inspected as text on 2026-08-22. No source archive, package, R object, dataset, index, or fitted output was downloaded, installed, loaded, executed, or tested.
